prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 2D game character sprite sheet
Primary request: Generate exactly one 1536 x 1024 RGBA sprite sheet containing two complete hand-painted Rook golem figures, one in each exact 768 x 1024 cell. Use a deliberately compact composition: every figure must fit inside a 640 px wide by 900 px tall safe box centered within its own cell, leaving at least 64 px transparent margin on the left and right and at least 48 px above and below. The full clenched fist must be completely inside the cell; absolutely no part of either fist, tower, pillar or foot may cross the x=768 center boundary or touch x=0/1536.
Input images: original Rook reference for identity; accepted painted Ogre and Knight references for the hand-painted 2D style.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no glow except tiny amber eyes.
Subject: preserve the original asymmetric Rook identity exactly: massive partly stone golem, tower/castle bastion on back and shoulder, one enormous continuous stone pillar arm, one single large fleshy clenched hand, blocky planted legs and complete feet, tiny amber eyes, cracks and masonry. It must remain visibly distinct from Ogre: no open palms, no symmetrical humanoid anatomy, no skirt as a main costume.
Style/medium: polished painted 2D fantasy game art, warm brush texture, dark contour accents, faceted stone, readable at board scale.
Composition/framing: left cell warm ivory army; right cell charcoal/slate army dominant over both stone and skin; matched pose, scale and ground anchor. Face and gaze read toward +x/right, while keeping the tower/pillar and fist as a clear asymmetric silhouette. If needed, scale the figures down rather than letting any object enter another cell.
Lighting/mood: clean studio form light with no cast shadow in transparent pixels.
Color palette: left figure warm bone ivory stone and mostly warm ivory skin with only restrained peach shading; right figure charcoal/slate stone and charcoal/slate skin; tiny amber eyes and tiny brass accents only.
Materials/textures: chipped battlements, layered masonry, rough pillar facets, subtle pores and cracks, hand-painted planes.
Constraints: exactly two figures, exact 1536 x 1024 canvas, exact 768 px cell split, generous transparent margins, full tower/pillar/fist/feet, genuine transparent alpha, no text or watermark.
Avoid: clipped fist, center-boundary overlap, edge contact, extra characters, duplicate limbs, long weapons, red cape, dark opaque background, painted checkerboard, floor shadow, cropped feet.
